title: How big the big room is
question: Is a room six gnomes tall and thirty wide the right size for the biggest space in a cave, or should the biggest one be much larger still?
context_md:
You said twice that you could not judge cave scale without context, so the gnome is standing in frame — he is 7 cells wide and 14 tall.

This is the largest room a full-size world produces (terraced, seed 1). The dark corridors leading off it to the right are typical: half of them are shorter than he is, so he cannot walk them without digging.

The room's outline is a circle, which is the shape you called a perfect oval. I am replacing how caves are made and want the size target settled first — the shape is being fixed regardless.

items.label: the largest room in a full-size world
